result.title: SAT-RL: Training Language Models for Logical Reasoning with Symbolic Solvers
result.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance in mathematical and logical reasoning, yet they still suffer from the curse of complexity and struggle as problem difficulty increases with the number of constraint interactions and the size of the search space. In contrast, satisfiability solvers such as Z3 provide scalable and verifiable reasoning through constraint solving under formal theories, but lack the flexibility to interpret natural-language problem descriptions. In this work, we propose SAT-RL, a reinforcement-learning (RL) framework that trains LLMs to interact with symbolic solvers through multi-turn tool execution. SAT-RL leverages synthetic data generation with verifiable solutions, supervised warm-up on solver-augmented traces, and solver-grounded reinforcement learning with tool-aware rewards. Experiments show that SAT-RL substantially improves symbolic reasoning with tools on both in-domain and out-of-domain logic tasks. Our code is available on https://github.com/sunjia72/SAT-RL.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SAT-RL：用强化学习训练 LLM 通过多轮调用 Z3 等符号求解器完成逻辑推理，结合可验证合成数据、求解器增强轨迹的监督热身与工具感知奖励，在域内和域外逻辑任务上提升表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「多轮工具调用＋工具感知奖励」的训练机制可能为 VLM 推理中何时获取视觉证据、如何依据外部工具结果分配贡献与决定停止提供可供核查的线索；但该工作不涉及视觉输入或 latent 状态生成，属纯文本工具 RL，迁移需自行验证。
